## Frontier topics
- Nuclear Fission: Next-gen reactors (SMR, molten salt, fast reactors), nuclear waste treatment, safety (https://library.tanaakk.com/en/frontier-topics/nuclear_fission)
- Nuclear Fusion: Magnetic confinement (tokamak, stellarator), inertial confinement, laser fusion (https://library.tanaakk.com/en/frontier-topics/nuclear_fusion)
- Superconductivity: High-temperature and room-temperature superconductivity, applications (transmission, MRI, quantum computing) (https://library.tanaakk.com/en/frontier-topics/superconductivity)
- Quantum Computing: Qubits, error correction, NISQ, algorithms (https://library.tanaakk.com/en/frontier-topics/quantum_computing)
- Artificial General Intelligence: AGI, foundation models, reasoning, agents (https://library.tanaakk.com/en/frontier-topics/artificial_general_intelligence)
- Synthetic Biology: Gene editing, metabolic engineering, artificial cells, biofoundries (https://library.tanaakk.com/en/frontier-topics/synthetic_biology)
- Brain-Computer Interface: Neural prosthetics, Neuralink-type, decoding and encoding (https://library.tanaakk.com/en/frontier-topics/brain_computer_interface)
- Carbon Capture & Utilization: DAC, CCS, CO2 conversion, negative emissions (https://library.tanaakk.com/en/frontier-topics/carbon_capture_utilization)
- Space Propulsion: Electric propulsion, nuclear propulsion, solar sail, antimatter (https://library.tanaakk.com/en/frontier-topics/space_propulsion)
- Longevity & Aging: Aging mechanisms, senolytics, lifespan extension (https://library.tanaakk.com/en/frontier-topics/longevity_aging)
- Solid-State Battery: Solid electrolyte, lithium metal, energy density (https://library.tanaakk.com/en/frontier-topics/solid_state_battery)
- Deep Geothermal: EGS, supercritical geothermal, drilling technology (https://library.tanaakk.com/en/frontier-topics/geothermal_deep)
- Gravitational Wave: LIGO/Virgo/KAGRA, multi-messenger astronomy, black hole and neutron star mergers (https://library.tanaakk.com/en/frontier-topics/gravitational_wave)
- Particle Physics: Extreme scales: zeptosecond (10^-21 s), subattometer (10^-19 m), LHC, future colliders (https://library.tanaakk.com/en/frontier-topics/particle_physics)
- Semiconductors: AI hardware, chiplets, advanced process, NorthPole-type accelerators (https://library.tanaakk.com/en/frontier-topics/semiconductors)
- Post-Quantum Cryptography: PQC, quantum-resistant cryptography, FIPS 203/204/205, key exchange and signatures (https://library.tanaakk.com/en/frontier-topics/post_quantum_cryptography)
- Climate & Weather AI: Atmospheric foundation models, Aurora/ClimaX, extreme weather prediction, ocean and pollution forecasting (https://library.tanaakk.com/en/frontier-topics/climate_weather_ai)
- Precision Medicine AI: Early cancer detection, drug discovery acceleration, protein design, multimodal medical AI (https://library.tanaakk.com/en/frontier-topics/precision_medicine_ai)
- Cybersecurity: Cryptography, resilience, infrastructure protection, zero trust (https://library.tanaakk.com/en/frontier-topics/cybersecurity)
- Trustworthy AI: AI safety, governance, factuality and grounding, privacy, AI risk management (https://library.tanaakk.com/en/frontier-topics/trustworthy_ai)
